_notes.autoEnable: Switch the ledger on at session start when files.ledger exists. /ledger on|off overrides this for the session.
_notes.reviewer.model: Prefer a capable model from a different family than the working agent. null = the chat model. The fallback is used when the primary is unavailable or the call fails.
_notes.files.modelFiles: What the reviewer reads and the monitor diffs. Archived code is ignored.
